hooks.command: cmux claude-hook session-start 2>/dev/null; cmux set-status claude-session 'Active' --icon '🟢' 2>/dev/null; cmux clear-status claude-notification 2>/dev/null; exit 0

input=$(cat); active=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false'); if [ "$active" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; cmux claude-hook stop 2>/dev/null; cmux set-status claude-session 'Idle' --icon '⏸' 2>/dev/null; cmux clear-status claude-notification 2>/dev/null; cmux clear-progress 2>/dev/null; exit 0

input=$(cat); ntype=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.notification_type // "unknown"'); cmux notify --title 'Claude Code' --body "$ntype" 2>/dev/null; cmux set-status claude-notification "$ntype" --icon '⚠️' 2>/dev/null; exit 0
input=$(cat); agent_type=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.agent_type // "agent"'); cmux set-status claude-subagent "$agent_type" --icon '🔄' 2>/dev/null; exit 0
